findings.title: Return as enacted response and restoration
findings.claim: The command to return can function as an enacted answer to the addressed Rabb and as restoration of the relation toward which the soul is directed.
findings.mechanism: The focus return form carries ordinary directed return; the Rabb destination, the supplied late speech context, the response facet, and the recovery facet make movement itself the answer that restores a relation.
findings.reader_payoff: Return becomes perceptible as a responsive act with restorative direction, while the plain command to turn back remains intact.
findings.containment: This is a relational reading of the commanded return, not a replacement for directed movement and not a claim that the word has only the response or recovery sense. The represented reader-walk support supplies the late-speech context; its additional facet pressure remains qualified.

epistemic.reason: A trusted cross-run finding and a legacy reader-walk activation converge on focus branches, but the latter has legacy-unbound provenance and broader context.

findings.title: Mutual acceptance in the paired participles
findings.claim: The soul's satisfaction and its being accepted can form a reciprocal relation, so the return is accompanied by willing alignment on both sides.
findings.mechanism: The active `رَاضِيَةً` and passive `مَّرْضِيَّةً` occupy adjacent focus words; the acceptance and reciprocal-acceptance facets make their opposite grammatical directions meet as one relation.
findings.reader_payoff: The two near-parallel descriptions become a visible exchange of acceptance rather than a repeated statement of one inward feeling.
findings.containment: The ordinary meanings pleased and pleasing remain available together. The represented support also cites unresolved و ث ق/B003 as a prior binding image; that citation is retained as a source limitation, not activated as an independently registered branch.

epistemic.reason: A trusted publication and a legacy reader walk identify the same focus pair, while the legacy source carries one unresolved neighboring citation.

findings.mechanism: The return word carries ordinary return and turning from a course, while `رَبِّكِ` carries both governance and step-by-step completion; their contact makes the destination a restored circuit of guidance and nurture.
findings.reader_payoff: The endpoint becomes relational: the reader can perceive return as restored participation in the one who governs by bringing a process to completion.
findings.containment: The plain directed return remains the floor. Governance and nurture are distinct activated facets held together here; this is not a claim that Rabb has only one lexical image or that the soul's prior course is specified in detail.

epistemic.reason: The reader-walk support names focus branch contacts and a changed reading, but its reader identity is legacy_unbound.
